jobs.title: IT Director, Enterprise Applications - Finance
jobs.description:
At Saputo, we bring good to the table by making high-quality products, investing in our people, and supporting communities around the world . As a top 10 global dairy processor, we value contributions that matter and strive to foster an inclusive, growth-driven work environment. Ready to bring your best?

Overview Of The Role

The IT Director - Enterprise Applications - Finance is accountable for the global strategy, delivery, and sustainment of Saputo's Finance technology landscape, with primary ownership of SAP Finance capabilities, Finance business intelligence and analytics solutions, and the enterprise applications used by the Finance functions across all Saputo divisions.

This role partners closely with business and IT leaders to modernize Finance processes, expand trusted self-service reporting and advanced analytics, embed responsible use of artificial intelligence into Finance capabilities and ways of working, and deliver scalable, resilient solutions across Saputo's global operations.

The IT Director provides people leadership, portfolio governance, and technology direction, ensuring Finance, BI, data, and AI solutions align with enterprise architecture, the SAP S/4HANA strategy, internal-controls requirements, responsible AI principles, and Saputo's operational and financial objectives. This leader acts as the executive escalation point for Finance applications and is accountable for value realization, operational stability, risk management, adoption, and continuous improvement.

How you will make contributions that matter:

Strategy & Product Ownership

Own the global Finance applications, business intelligence, analytics, and AI strategy and roadmap, aligned with business transformation priorities, the SAP S/4HANA program, enterprise data strategy, and digital objectives.
Define and enforce global design standards, solution patterns, governance, and lifecycle plans across Finance processes and applications.
Define the vision and operating model for Finance reporting and analytics, including governed semantic models, certified datasets, self-service BI, executive dashboards, and advanced analytics.
Partner with Finance and IT leaders to translate business strategy, regulatory needs, and operational priorities into a sequenced technology portfolio.
Act as the primary executive interface for Finance solutions, clearly communicating roadmap, investments, delivery status, risks, decisions, and business outcomes.

Delivery & Portfolio Management

Lead large-scale, multi-region programs, including SAP Finance implementations, BI and analytics solutions, system activities related to acquisitions and divestitures, and Finance modernization initiatives.
Oversee the end-to-end delivery lifecycle: discovery, requirements, solution design, build and configuration, testing, data conversion, cutover, hypercare, and benefits tracking.
Partner with Data team to direct the end-to-end delivery of BI products, from use-case definition and data modeling through dashboard design, testing, deployment, adoption, support, and benefits realization.
Partner with the Digital team to establish an AI delivery pipeline that identifies valuable Finance use cases, validates data readiness and controls, conducts proofs of concept, scales successful solutions, and monitors adoption, quality, risk, and business value.
Manage portfolio funding, prioritization, dependencies, risk, and resource capacity across internal teams, business stakeholders, and system integrators.
Ensure delivery follows Saputo IT methodologies, architecture standards, release governance, security requirements, and change-management practices.
Lead technology due diligence, integration planning, application rationalization, and business process harmonization activities associated with acquisitions and divestitures.

People Leadership

Lead and develop a team of IT professionals skilled in Finance processes and solutions.
Build strong succession plans and skills development paths while fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
Establish clear accountability, objectives, and performance expectations while fostering collaboration, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
Coach team to operate as trusted partners to Finance and to make sound, enterprise-minded decisions.

Architecture, Integration & Data

Govern the Finance solution architecture and integrations across SAP ECC or SAP S/4HANA, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, enterprise data platforms, AI services, and adjacent applications.
Ensure BI solutions use trusted, reconciled Finance data, reusable semantic models, clear data ownership, consistent financial definitions, and role-appropriate access controls.
Champion SAP best practices, design principles, reusable design patterns, and sustainable extension strategies.
Ensure financial data integrity, master-data alignment, reconciliation, traceability, and end-to-end process visibility across systems and regions.
Partner with Enterprise Architecture, BI, Data, Integration, Infrastructure, Digital and Security teams to ensure solutions are scalable, resilient, secure, and supportable.
Partner with Digital, Analytics, AI, Security, Privacy, Legal, and Risk teams to apply responsible AI practices, including human oversight, transparency, data protection, model governance, and ongoing monitoring.
Embed AI capabilities into Finance processes and products where they provide measurable value, including intelligent insights, anomaly detection, forecasting, narrative generation, workflow assistance, and user productivity.

Controls, Risk & Compliance

Embed internal controls, security-by-design, access governance, segregation of duties, auditability, data protection into Finance solution delivery and operations.
Partner with Finance, Internal Audit, Security, Privacy, and Risk teams to address control requirements and remediate findings.
Ensure appropriate governance for financially sensitive data, interfaces, configurations, workflows, and production changes.
Maintain technology currency and lifecycle plans to reduce operational, compliance, and obsolescence risk.

Operations & Sustainment

Own the global sustainment model for Finance applications, ensuring operational stability, predictable service levels, and effective business support which meets established Service Level Agreements.
Oversee Level 3 support, major-incident management, root-cause analysis, problem management, and continuous-improvement backlogs.
Ensure month-end, quarter-end, and year-end business-critical processes are supported through robust readiness, monitoring, and escalation practices.
Monitor service performance, technical debt, recurring incidents, vendor performance, and improvement outcomes, taking corrective action where required.

Financial & Vendor Management

Own budget planning and financial stewardship for the Finance applications portfolio, including project investments, operating costs, licenses, and external services.
Manage strategic vendor and system-integrator relationships, including statements of work, delivery quality, commercial performance, and accountability for outcomes.
Build business cases and value measures that connect Finance, BI, analytics, and AI investments to control improvement, decision quality, efficiency, risk reduction, employee experience, and business capability.

You are best suited for the role if you have the following qualifications:

15+ years of progressive IT experience delivering enterprise-scale solutions, including 10+ years in SAP Finance and demonstrated leadership delivering business intelligence, analytics, or data-enabled Finance solutions.
Deep expertise in SAP Finance solutions and business processes supporting complex manufacturing environments.
Proven track record leading the successful design, implementation, optimization, and support of SAP Finance solutions across large-scale transformation programs.
Experience operating within a global SAP template and rollout model, balancing global standards with legitimate regional requirements.
Excellent communication and executive presence, with the ability to influence, simplify complex topics, resolve conflict, and align senior business and IT leaders.
Proven leadership delivering large, complex ERP, BI or data transformation programs spanning multiple sites, regions, business units, and stakeholder groups.
Demonstrated experience identifying and scaling practical AI use cases in Finance or enterprise applications, with appropriate attention to data quality, controls, security, privacy, transparency, human oversight, and measurable value.
Demonstrated experience delivering executive dashboards, operational reporting, self-service BI, governed semantic models, and advanced analytics using platforms such as Microsoft Fabric and Power BI.
Demonstrated people leadership experience managing global teams, managed services teams, system integrators and other vendors.
Strong understanding of financial controls, segregation of duties, audit readiness, data governance, and security requirements in a public-company environment.
Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, or a related discipline.
For candidates based in Montreal, proficiency in both English and French is required, as the position involves ongoing communication and collaboration with stakeholders across Canada

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in food, dairy, manufacturing, distribution, or consumer packaged goods industries.
Experience with SAP S/4HANA Finance transformation and migration from SAP ECC.
Hands-on leadership experience with Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, including data engineering, lakehouse or warehouse patterns, semantic models, governance, deployment, and adoption.
Experience with Microsoft Copilot, SAP Joule, machine learning, or generative AI solutions applied to Finance processes and decision support.
Accounting designation, MBA, or relevant SAP, project management, architecture, or service-management certification.

We support and take care of our employees and their families by offering :

Competitive salaries
A hybrid work environment with the possibility to work from home 2 days a week
Advantageous corporate agreements
Full range of group insurance benefits
Group retirement pension plan with employer contribution
Purchase option of company stocks
Group RRSP
Health and wellness program in the workplace
Assistance program for employees and their families
Saputo products at a discounted price

Salary: $163,765 to $214,940

Salary offers will vary commensurate with experience, education, skills, and training.

STATEMENT ON AI

All applications are carefully considered by our Talent Acquisition team.

Artificial Intelligence tools may be used in screening applications.

Artificial Intelligence is not used to assess or select applications.

In Canada, Saputo is a leading cheese manufacturer and fluid milk and cream processor, with a portfolio of well-loved brands such as Dairyland, Armstrong, Neilson, Alexis de Portneuf, and many more. Whether your expertise lies in manufacturing, operations, supply chain management, sales, quality assurance, or in any other function, your role is integral to our success. You will make contributions that matter, all while working alongside colleagues who genuinely care about your success and who will roll up their sleeves to help.

jobs.title: Managing Director, Project Delivery
jobs.description:
At ATB, we exist to make it possible for our clients, team members and communities. Our purpose is more than aspirational. It's a real commitment we live every day through our values (what we call the ATB ID).

About

Life at ATB is about more than work. In fact, we’re consistently recognized as one of Canada's top employers thanks to our high-care, high-performance culture, upheld by the three commitments we make to our team members:

Impact in action:
No matter where you are in the organization, you're empowered to make an impact in the lives of our clients and communities.

Thrive together:
We want you—the unique, authentic you—to feel safe and celebrated at work. We're on a continuous journey to build the most flexible and inclusive programs.

Ready for tomorrow:
We want to enable your success through interesting and challenging work, performance enablement, and learning and development.

Leadership is in our DNA at ATB, reflecting our commitment to developing world-class leaders who can truly thrive. Our Leader DNA model sets the standard for how we lead people, drive business performance, and shape a dynamic future. This is the place for purpose-driven individuals ready to deliver impactful leadership every day.

About The Role

As ATB's next Managing Director of Wealth & Investment Management Enablement,
you will work as a senior leader on our Wealth Operations & Enablement team to deliver against the Wealth and Investment Management strategy contributing to the ATB path to 2030. Collaborating with key partners across the organization, you are responsible for the business ownership of technology and the execution of the technology roadmap within Wealth Management. You will oversee the intake of all new technology projects and sustainment initiatives, ensuring that wealth programs and business initiatives are driving transformation while remaining on track and on budget. Specifically, this role functions as a critical bridge between Wealth business objectives and technology delivery, shaping interactions, managing complex project portfolios, and enabling client-centric moments that unlock impact.

Accountabilities

Responsible for the execution of the Wealth Management technology roadmap, acting as the primary business owner for wealth technology stack.
Manage the comprehensive intake process for all new technology projects and sustainment initiatives.
Oversee all wealth programs that are key business initiatives, ensuring wealth operating plans are delivered on track and on budget.
Provides day to day leadership of the Wealth and IM Enablement teams.
Steers vision, prioritizes efforts, sets goals and serves as champion to deliver on those goals.
Partner with Enterprise Architecture and IT partners to deliver against prioritized capability roadmaps and help influence organizational priorities.
Manages budgets, strategic plans, and regular reporting on portfolio health to executive leadership.
Models leadership behaviour by example and acts as a mentor for Directors and cross-functional teams.
Drives innovation across the organization by leveraging data to reimagine wealth journeys and experiences.
Continues to identify, create and support value streams that drive Wealth business metrics.
Develops detailed business case benefits to support value streams and prioritization.
Leads teams to provide detailed business requirements when partnering with technology delivery partners.
Leads teams and business in prioritization of intake and delivery across wealth in partnership with technology teams to deliver highest value creation against key wealth strategic direction.

Skills, Experience & Requirements

Characteristics

Enterprise Wealth Expertise: Big-picture thinker with deep knowledge of end-to-end wealth management processes, advisor enablement technologies, and emerging regulatory trends.
Strategic Execution: Skilled at overseeing program governance, strategy, and operations managing complex technology transformations from initiation through implementation while tracking KPIs, schedules, and deliverables.
Executive Influence & Collaboration: Natural leader and bridge between business and technology, adept at facilitating discussions with senior executives, building consensus across business units and external vendors, and navigating complex team dynamics.
People Leadership: Proven track record of building high-performing teams, nurturing senior talent, and attracting and retaining top talent at ATB.
Client & Business Curiosity: Analytical problem-solver who effectively challenges the status quo to drive both client value and business results.

Requirements (Core Skills, Education & Experience)

Experience: 10+ years in Wealth Management, Banking, or Financial Services technology, with extensive experience in large-scale business technology transformation and roadmap execution.
Education: Post-secondary degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field (Graduate degree or MBA is an asset).
Program & Budget Management: Proven track record of managing large-scale budgets and delivering complex programs on time and on budget.
Leadership: Strong executive presence with demonstrated ability to influence and communicate across all organizational levels.

Don’t meet all the requirements on the list?

A resume only goes so far in expressing who you are and the unique perspectives you bring. If you believe your skills and experience align with the role—but you might not check all the boxes—we want to hear from you. We encourage candidates from all work backgrounds, equity-seeking communities and experience levels to apply. If you’re seeking a career where your drive, perspective and growth are celebrated, we want to hear from you.

We’re dedicated to building a workforce reflective of those within our communities, and a culture where our team members are equipped with what they need to succeed—their way. Part of creating an inclusive workplace is recognizing our role in advancing Truth and Reconciliation. We are committed to meeting and exceeding the standards set out in the Partnership Accreditation in Indigenous Relations program created by the Canadian Council for Indigenous Business.

What happens next?

If you are shortlisted, you’ll hear from us after the posting closes. Check out our How We Hire page to learn more about our hiring process. If you need any accommodations throughout this process, please let us know at talentteam@atb.com

Stay in touch

We’re excited that you’re interested in a career with ATB. Follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram to learn more about what our team is up to.

jobs.title: Deputy Director, Capacity Development and Implementation Bureau
jobs.description:
Org. Setting and Reporting

The Capacity Development and Implementation Bureau (CDI) contributes to all of ICAO's Strategic Goals, namely: (i) Every Flight is Safe and Secure; (ii) Aviation is Environmentally Sustainable; (iii) Aviation Delivers Seamless, Accessible, and Reliable Mobility for All; (iv) No Country Left Behind; (v) The International Civil Aviation Convention and Other Treaties, Laws and Regulations Address All Challenges; and (vi) The Economic Development of Air Transport Assures the Delivery of Economic Prosperity and Societal Well-Being for All. It helps Member States turn ICAO Standards and policies into effective and sustainable results. Through needs-based implementation support, projects, training, and innovative products and services, CDI helps States close implementation gaps and build lasting aviation capacity, in line with the "No Country Left Behind" strategic goal. The Bureau manages ICAO’s Capacity Development and Implementation Programme (CDIP) across all Regions, including field operations and procurement services. It also oversees ICAO’s global aviation training activities, including the TRAINAIR PLUS Programme, and its revenue-generating products and services. CDI supports two of the Organization’s High Priority Enablers: “Partnerships, Resource Mobilization and Financial Sustainability” and “Gender Equality and Attracting New Talent to Aviation.” Across these activities, the Bureau oversees planning, budgeting, quality assurance and risk management to provide coordinated, high-quality support to States and help maintain ICAO’s financial sustainability. The Deputy Director reports to the Director, CDI (D/CDI), and manages the Bureau’s operations in line with the Director’s instructions. The Deputy Director oversees CDI’s business planning, quality management and continuous improvement, and represents the Director when required. The role carries full responsibility for managing the staff and resources under its authority, including setting priorities, assigning work, coaching staff and evaluating performance.

Responsibilities

Function 1 (incl. Expected results) Contributes to the formulation of the Bureau’s strategic priorities and work programme under the Director’s guidance, coordinates the preparation of business and operational plans, budget and staffing proposals for the Director’s consideration, and oversees the management of human and financial resources within delegated authority, achieving results such as:

Contributes to the formulation of the Bureau’s strategic priorities and work programme, ensuring alignment with the ICAO Strategic Plan and organizational priorities.
Coordinates the preparation of the Bureau’s Business and Operating Plans for the Director’s review, and monitors implementation and performance against agreed objectives.
Coordinates annual and triennial staffing and budget requirements, including workforce and succession planning, and prepares related documentation for the Director’s review and submission to the approving authorities.
Ensures consistent financial management across CDI’s funding mechanisms to support informed decision-making and resource allocation.
Recommends changes to the Bureau’s structure and working methods for the Director’s consideration, in response to developments in the business environment and industry.
Directs and manages staff within delegated authority, sets priorities, delegates tasks, evaluates performance, promotes teamwork and oversees recruitment in accordance with ICAO’s rules and selection procedures. Function 2 (incl. Expected results) Directs the Capacity Development and Implementation Programme (CDIP) and ICAO's global aviation training activities, including field operations, procurement and the TRAINAIR PLUS Programme, and ensures a One-ICAO approach with Regional Offices and other Bureaus, achieving results such as:
Directs the strategy and work programme of the CDIP, so that implementation support projects are delivered efficiently and to a high standard.
Directs the planning, development and deployment of ICAO's aviation training activities, and of the TRAINAIR PLUS Programme.
Ensures a One-ICAO approach by aligning CDIP activities with the Regular Programme, Regional Offices and other Bureaus, including sharing implementation support data with the Air Navigation and Air Transport Bureaus.
Works with Regional Offices to identify and deliver projects that address States' deficiencies, including Significant Safety and Security Concerns, in support of the No Country Left Behind goal and the ICAO Policy on Implementation Support.
Coordinates CDI's input to the Monitoring and Assistance Review Board (MARB), and monitors and reports on the support provided to MARB States. Function 3 (incl. Expected results) Leads the development and management of ICAO's revenue-generating products and services, including product development, marketing and sales, to strengthen the Organization's financial sustainability, achieving results such as:
Directs the strategy and portfolio of ICAO's revenue-generating products and services, including events, publications, licensing and data services, and the development of new products and services, so they meet Member States' and stakeholders' needs and support the Regular Budget.
Directs the marketing, sales, e-commerce and distribution of ICAO products and services, including printing and publication services.
Meets the approved targets and ensures that revenue-generating activities follow ICAO's applicable policies, pricing principles and intellectual property requirements, and monitors and reports on their financial performance.
Promotes the identification and assessment of new funding opportunities for the Organization, including new revenue streams, business models and commercial partnerships, and prepares proposals for CDI to submit to the relevant decision-making bodies. Function 4 (incl. Expected results) Leads the High Priority Enablers under CDI's responsibility, including Partnerships, Resource Mobilization and Financial Sustainability, and Gender Equality and Attracting New Talent to Aviation, achieving results such as:
Leads the development and implementation of ICAO's Resource Mobilization Strategy, including the ICAO Global Appeal, to secure voluntary contributions for the Organization's priorities.
Builds and maintains strategic partnerships with Member States, donors, development partners, international organizations and other stakeholders that provide voluntary contributions or in-kind support, including through dialogues with development partners and high-level pledging events.
Meets approved resource mobilization targets, strengthens resource mobilization capacity across the Secretariat, including in the Regional Offices, and coordinates resource mobilization efforts throughout ICAO.
Directs the Gender Equality Programme, the Next Generation of Aviation Professionals (NGAP) Programme and the ICAO Global Ambassadors Programme, to help build a diverse, future-ready aviation workforce.
Monitors and reports on progress under both High Priority Enablers, including the voluntary contributions mobilized and the results achieved. Function 5 (incl. Expected results) Leads quality management, continuous improvement and digital evolution in CDI, including the Quality Management System, change management, and follow-up on audits and evaluations, achieving results such as:
Maintains and improves CDI's Quality Management System, including the Project Quality Assurance Process, so that the Bureau's projects, products and services meet consistent quality standards.
Leads the review and improvement of the Bureau's business processes, policies and procedures to increase efficiency, accountability and client satisfaction.
Directs CDI's digital strategy and the development of its systems and tools, in coordination with the Organization's information and communications technology function.
Ensures that recommendations from internal and external audits, evaluations and oversight bodies, such as the Joint Inspection Unit (JIU) and the Evaluation and Audit Advisory Committee (EAAC), are implemented on time.
Contributes to the ICAO Continuous Organizational Improvement (COI) Programme and leads CDI's related change management initiatives. Function 6 (incl. Expected results) Represents CDI and provides strategic advice to senior management and governing bodies, and the Implementation Support Group (ISG) including leading the preparation of documentation for the Council, the Technical Cooperation Committee (TCC) and the Finance Committee (FIC), and other meetings achieving results such as:
Leads the preparation of working papers, reports and briefings for the Council, the TCC, the FIC and the Assembly, making sure they are accurate, timely and consistent with the Organization's positions.
Provides strategic and policy advice to the Director and senior management on capacity development, implementation support and related matters.
Acts as Secretary to the Implementation Support Group (ISG), ensuring the effective conduct of its meetings and identifying where CDI can help implement agreed directions.
Represents CDI and the Director, as required, at meetings of governing bodies, conferences, high-level events and external forums.
Promotes the role and value of CDI within the Secretariat and with Member States, partners and other stakeholders.
Ensures that the decisions and recommendations of the governing bodies that concern CDI are followed up and implemented. Function 7 (incl. Expected results) Performs other related duties, as assigned.

Competencies

Professionalism: Thorough knowledge of ICAO’s functions, programmes and activities related to aviation safety, aviation security, environmental protection, and safety/security audits. Knowledge of the Convention on International Civil Aviation and its Annexes, ICAO Standards and Recommended Practices (SARPs) and their application. Understanding of ICAO’s Strategic Objectives, and its global and regional aviation plans. Proven ability in developing/managing aviation-related projects and managing procurement of goods and services. Proven ability to plan, direct and supervise a broad area of institutional work, and to decide or advise on solutions to important problems of policy and practice. FullTime

Bolton, ON

Husky TechnologiesTM a company with a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships, a strong sense of community and a unique culture and values. We are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM Canadian manufacturing facilities and global headquarters are located in Bolton, Ontario on a large, beautiful campus located just 20 minutes north of Toronto’s Pearson International Airport. Features include a fitness and wellness center, intramural sports activities, on-site cafeteria, and clean, state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities with outstanding safety records. We offer a great work environment and competitive total compensation package, including above market retirement savings plan and market competitive group benefits.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Director / GM, Global Marketing & Sales Enablement
is responsible for defining and driving Husky's global brand strategy, leading B2B marketing and demand generation, advancing sustainability advocacy and industry engagement, delivering actionable market intelligence, and improving global sales effectiveness.

Reporting to the EVP, Sales & Marketing, this leader will strengthen Husky's market position and industry influence, build an integrated commercial support function, and connect market insights, customer engagement, and sales capabilities to deliver measurable business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Global Brand Strategy, Marketing & Industry Advocacy
Own Husky's global brand strategy, positioning, identity, and differentiation, ensuring a compelling and consistent presence across markets and customer touchpoints.
Develop and execute global B2B marketing programs that generate qualified leads and commercial opportunities through digital channels, integrated campaigns, account-based marketing, trade shows, and customer events.
Lead Husky's sustainability advocacy and industry engagement strategy, partnering with industry associations, customers, and value-chain stakeholders to advance science-based understanding of plastics, address misconceptions, and promote responsible use, recycling, and circularity.
Represent Husky's perspectives in relevant industry initiatives and advocacy programs, strengthening its reputation as a credible technology leader and constructive voice in sustainability discussions.
Establish metrics to evaluate brand strength, marketing contribution to pipeline, and the reach and effectiveness of advocacy initiatives.
Market Intelligence & Strategic Insights
Lead a centralized market intelligence and research capability serving Sales, Product Line Management, Strategy, Investor Relations, and executive leadership.
Deliver actionable insights on market trends, competitive dynamics, customer needs, sustainability-related market developments, and emerging growth opportunities.
Support strategic planning, market prioritization, product portfolio decisions, and commercial growth initiatives.
Establish systematic approaches to market research, competitive intelligence, and voice-of-customer analysis.
Strategic Customer Engagement & Sales Enablement
Lead the development of executive-level content and strategic narratives for Top-to-Top (T2T) customer meetings, supporting senior leadership and strategic account engagement.
Develop high-impact sales enablement content, including value propositions, product and solution presentations, competitive positioning, case studies, and customer value tools.
Partner with Sales, Product Line Management, and Engineering to ensure differentiated, consistent, and customer-focused messaging.
Equip global commercial teams with the content, knowledge, and capabilities required to engage customers effectively and win business.
Sales Effectiveness & Commercial Excellence
Partner with Sales leadership to improve sales productivity, commercial processes, opportunity management, and overall sales effectiveness.
Drive adoption of sales methodologies, CRM capabilities, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions to strengthen commercial execution.
Develop scalable approaches to sales training, onboarding, best-practice sharing, and continuous improvement of capability.
Establish performance metrics and improvement initiatives focused on sales efficiency, conversion rates, win rates, and commercial productivity.

Leadership & Experience

The successful candidate will be a strategic, commercially oriented leader with proven experience in global brand management, complex industrial B2B marketing, market intelligence, and sales enablement.

Experience engaging industry associations, building external partnerships, and shaping industry narratives around sustainability, circularity, or related topics is highly desirable.

The role requires strong business acumen, the ability to lead global multidisciplinary teams, and the credibility to influence executive stakeholders while translating market insights and brand strategy into measurable commercial outcomes.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or other advanced business degree considered an asset
10+ years of progressive leadership experience in global B2B marketing, brand strategy, commercial excellence, or sales enablement within a complex industrial, manufacturing, technology, or capital equipment environment
Demonstrated success developing and executing integrated marketing strategies that drive brand growth, lead generation, customer engagement, and measurable commercial results across global markets.
Proven experience leveraging market intelligence, competitive insights, and voice-of-customer research to influence business strategy, portfolio decisions, and growth initiatives.
Strong track record leading cross-functional and global teams, influencing executive stakeholders, and driving adoption of sales methodologies, CRM platforms, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions to improve sales effectiveness.

Vacancy: Replacement

Pay Range: $150,000.00 - 185,000.00

Husky Technologies TM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks.

No agency or telephone inquiries please.

new_jobs.title: IT Director, Enterprise Applications - Finance
new_jobs.description:
At Saputo, we bring good to the table by making high-quality products, investing in our people, and supporting communities around the world . As a top 10 global dairy processor, we value contributions that matter and strive to foster an inclusive, growth-driven work environment. Ready to bring your best?

Overview Of The Role

The IT Director - Enterprise Applications - Finance is accountable for the global strategy, delivery, and sustainment of Saputo's Finance technology landscape, with primary ownership of SAP Finance capabilities, Finance business intelligence and analytics solutions, and the enterprise applications used by the Finance functions across all Saputo divisions.

This role partners closely with business and IT leaders to modernize Finance processes, expand trusted self-service reporting and advanced analytics, embed responsible use of artificial intelligence into Finance capabilities and ways of working, and deliver scalable, resilient solutions across Saputo's global operations.

The IT Director provides people leadership, portfolio governance, and technology direction, ensuring Finance, BI, data, and AI solutions align with enterprise architecture, the SAP S/4HANA strategy, internal-controls requirements, responsible AI principles, and Saputo's operational and financial objectives. This leader acts as the executive escalation point for Finance applications and is accountable for value realization, operational stability, risk management, adoption, and continuous improvement.

How you will make contributions that matter:

Strategy & Product Ownership

Own the global Finance applications, business intelligence, analytics, and AI strategy and roadmap, aligned with business transformation priorities, the SAP S/4HANA program, enterprise data strategy, and digital objectives.
Define and enforce global design standards, solution patterns, governance, and lifecycle plans across Finance processes and applications.
Define the vision and operating model for Finance reporting and analytics, including governed semantic models, certified datasets, self-service BI, executive dashboards, and advanced analytics.
Partner with Finance and IT leaders to translate business strategy, regulatory needs, and operational priorities into a sequenced technology portfolio.
Act as the primary executive interface for Finance solutions, clearly communicating roadmap, investments, delivery status, risks, decisions, and business outcomes.

Delivery & Portfolio Management

Lead large-scale, multi-region programs, including SAP Finance implementations, BI and analytics solutions, system activities related to acquisitions and divestitures, and Finance modernization initiatives.
Oversee the end-to-end delivery lifecycle: discovery, requirements, solution design, build and configuration, testing, data conversion, cutover, hypercare, and benefits tracking.
Partner with Data team to direct the end-to-end delivery of BI products, from use-case definition and data modeling through dashboard design, testing, deployment, adoption, support, and benefits realization.
Partner with the Digital team to establish an AI delivery pipeline that identifies valuable Finance use cases, validates data readiness and controls, conducts proofs of concept, scales successful solutions, and monitors adoption, quality, risk, and business value.
Manage portfolio funding, prioritization, dependencies, risk, and resource capacity across internal teams, business stakeholders, and system integrators.
Ensure delivery follows Saputo IT methodologies, architecture standards, release governance, security requirements, and change-management practices.
Lead technology due diligence, integration planning, application rationalization, and business process harmonization activities associated with acquisitions and divestitures.

People Leadership

Lead and develop a team of IT professionals skilled in Finance processes and solutions.
Build strong succession plans and skills development paths while fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
Establish clear accountability, objectives, and performance expectations while fostering collaboration, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
Coach team to operate as trusted partners to Finance and to make sound, enterprise-minded decisions.

Architecture, Integration & Data

Govern the Finance solution architecture and integrations across SAP ECC or SAP S/4HANA, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, enterprise data platforms, AI services, and adjacent applications.
Ensure BI solutions use trusted, reconciled Finance data, reusable semantic models, clear data ownership, consistent financial definitions, and role-appropriate access controls.
Champion SAP best practices, design principles, reusable design patterns, and sustainable extension strategies.
Ensure financial data integrity, master-data alignment, reconciliation, traceability, and end-to-end process visibility across systems and regions.
Partner with Enterprise Architecture, BI, Data, Integration, Infrastructure, Digital and Security teams to ensure solutions are scalable, resilient, secure, and supportable.
Partner with Digital, Analytics, AI, Security, Privacy, Legal, and Risk teams to apply responsible AI practices, including human oversight, transparency, data protection, model governance, and ongoing monitoring.
Embed AI capabilities into Finance processes and products where they provide measurable value, including intelligent insights, anomaly detection, forecasting, narrative generation, workflow assistance, and user productivity.

Controls, Risk & Compliance

Embed internal controls, security-by-design, access governance, segregation of duties, auditability, data protection into Finance solution delivery and operations.
Partner with Finance, Internal Audit, Security, Privacy, and Risk teams to address control requirements and remediate findings.
Ensure appropriate governance for financially sensitive data, interfaces, configurations, workflows, and production changes.
Maintain technology currency and lifecycle plans to reduce operational, compliance, and obsolescence risk.

Operations & Sustainment

Own the global sustainment model for Finance applications, ensuring operational stability, predictable service levels, and effective business support which meets established Service Level Agreements.
Oversee Level 3 support, major-incident management, root-cause analysis, problem management, and continuous-improvement backlogs.
Ensure month-end, quarter-end, and year-end business-critical processes are supported through robust readiness, monitoring, and escalation practices.
Monitor service performance, technical debt, recurring incidents, vendor performance, and improvement outcomes, taking corrective action where required.

Financial & Vendor Management

Own budget planning and financial stewardship for the Finance applications portfolio, including project investments, operating costs, licenses, and external services.
Manage strategic vendor and system-integrator relationships, including statements of work, delivery quality, commercial performance, and accountability for outcomes.
Build business cases and value measures that connect Finance, BI, analytics, and AI investments to control improvement, decision quality, efficiency, risk reduction, employee experience, and business capability.

You are best suited for the role if you have the following qualifications:

15+ years of progressive IT experience delivering enterprise-scale solutions, including 10+ years in SAP Finance and demonstrated leadership delivering business intelligence, analytics, or data-enabled Finance solutions.
Deep expertise in SAP Finance solutions and business processes supporting complex manufacturing environments.
Proven track record leading the successful design, implementation, optimization, and support of SAP Finance solutions across large-scale transformation programs.
Experience operating within a global SAP template and rollout model, balancing global standards with legitimate regional requirements.
Excellent communication and executive presence, with the ability to influence, simplify complex topics, resolve conflict, and align senior business and IT leaders.
Proven leadership delivering large, complex ERP, BI or data transformation programs spanning multiple sites, regions, business units, and stakeholder groups.
Demonstrated experience identifying and scaling practical AI use cases in Finance or enterprise applications, with appropriate attention to data quality, controls, security, privacy, transparency, human oversight, and measurable value.
Demonstrated experience delivering executive dashboards, operational reporting, self-service BI, governed semantic models, and advanced analytics using platforms such as Microsoft Fabric and Power BI.
Demonstrated people leadership experience managing global teams, managed services teams, system integrators and other vendors.
Strong understanding of financial controls, segregation of duties, audit readiness, data governance, and security requirements in a public-company environment.
Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, or a related discipline.
For candidates based in Montreal, proficiency in both English and French is required, as the position involves ongoing communication and collaboration with stakeholders across Canada

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in food, dairy, manufacturing, distribution, or consumer packaged goods industries.
Experience with SAP S/4HANA Finance transformation and migration from SAP ECC.
Hands-on leadership experience with Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, including data engineering, lakehouse or warehouse patterns, semantic models, governance, deployment, and adoption.
Experience with Microsoft Copilot, SAP Joule, machine learning, or generative AI solutions applied to Finance processes and decision support.
Accounting designation, MBA, or relevant SAP, project management, architecture, or service-management certification.

We support and take care of our employees and their families by offering :

Competitive salaries
A hybrid work environment with the possibility to work from home 2 days a week
Advantageous corporate agreements
Full range of group insurance benefits
Group retirement pension plan with employer contribution
Purchase option of company stocks
Group RRSP
Health and wellness program in the workplace
Assistance program for employees and their families
Saputo products at a discounted price

Salary: $163,765 to $214,940

Salary offers will vary commensurate with experience, education, skills, and training.

STATEMENT ON AI

All applications are carefully considered by our Talent Acquisition team.

Artificial Intelligence tools may be used in screening applications.

Artificial Intelligence is not used to assess or select applications.

In Canada, Saputo is a leading cheese manufacturer and fluid milk and cream processor, with a portfolio of well-loved brands such as Dairyland, Armstrong, Neilson, Alexis de Portneuf, and many more. Whether your expertise lies in manufacturing, operations, supply chain management, sales, quality assurance, or in any other function, your role is integral to our success. You will make contributions that matter, all while working alongside colleagues who genuinely care about your success and who will roll up their sleeves to help.

new_jobs.title: Managing Director, Project Delivery
new_jobs.description:
At ATB, we exist to make it possible for our clients, team members and communities. Our purpose is more than aspirational. It's a real commitment we live every day through our values (what we call the ATB ID).

About

Life at ATB is about more than work. In fact, we’re consistently recognized as one of Canada's top employers thanks to our high-care, high-performance culture, upheld by the three commitments we make to our team members:

Impact in action:
No matter where you are in the organization, you're empowered to make an impact in the lives of our clients and communities.

Thrive together:
We want you—the unique, authentic you—to feel safe and celebrated at work. We're on a continuous journey to build the most flexible and inclusive programs.

Ready for tomorrow:
We want to enable your success through interesting and challenging work, performance enablement, and learning and development.

Leadership is in our DNA at ATB, reflecting our commitment to developing world-class leaders who can truly thrive. Our Leader DNA model sets the standard for how we lead people, drive business performance, and shape a dynamic future. This is the place for purpose-driven individuals ready to deliver impactful leadership every day.

About The Role

As ATB's next Managing Director of Wealth & Investment Management Enablement,
you will work as a senior leader on our Wealth Operations & Enablement team to deliver against the Wealth and Investment Management strategy contributing to the ATB path to 2030. Collaborating with key partners across the organization, you are responsible for the business ownership of technology and the execution of the technology roadmap within Wealth Management. You will oversee the intake of all new technology projects and sustainment initiatives, ensuring that wealth programs and business initiatives are driving transformation while remaining on track and on budget. Specifically, this role functions as a critical bridge between Wealth business objectives and technology delivery, shaping interactions, managing complex project portfolios, and enabling client-centric moments that unlock impact.

Accountabilities

Responsible for the execution of the Wealth Management technology roadmap, acting as the primary business owner for wealth technology stack.
Manage the comprehensive intake process for all new technology projects and sustainment initiatives.
Oversee all wealth programs that are key business initiatives, ensuring wealth operating plans are delivered on track and on budget.
Provides day to day leadership of the Wealth and IM Enablement teams.
Steers vision, prioritizes efforts, sets goals and serves as champion to deliver on those goals.
Partner with Enterprise Architecture and IT partners to deliver against prioritized capability roadmaps and help influence organizational priorities.
Manages budgets, strategic plans, and regular reporting on portfolio health to executive leadership.
Models leadership behaviour by example and acts as a mentor for Directors and cross-functional teams.
Drives innovation across the organization by leveraging data to reimagine wealth journeys and experiences.
Continues to identify, create and support value streams that drive Wealth business metrics.
Develops detailed business case benefits to support value streams and prioritization.
Leads teams to provide detailed business requirements when partnering with technology delivery partners.
Leads teams and business in prioritization of intake and delivery across wealth in partnership with technology teams to deliver highest value creation against key wealth strategic direction.

Skills, Experience & Requirements

Characteristics

Enterprise Wealth Expertise: Big-picture thinker with deep knowledge of end-to-end wealth management processes, advisor enablement technologies, and emerging regulatory trends.
Strategic Execution: Skilled at overseeing program governance, strategy, and operations managing complex technology transformations from initiation through implementation while tracking KPIs, schedules, and deliverables.
Executive Influence & Collaboration: Natural leader and bridge between business and technology, adept at facilitating discussions with senior executives, building consensus across business units and external vendors, and navigating complex team dynamics.
People Leadership: Proven track record of building high-performing teams, nurturing senior talent, and attracting and retaining top talent at ATB.
Client & Business Curiosity: Analytical problem-solver who effectively challenges the status quo to drive both client value and business results.

Requirements (Core Skills, Education & Experience)

Experience: 10+ years in Wealth Management, Banking, or Financial Services technology, with extensive experience in large-scale business technology transformation and roadmap execution.
Education: Post-secondary degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field (Graduate degree or MBA is an asset).
Program & Budget Management: Proven track record of managing large-scale budgets and delivering complex programs on time and on budget.
Leadership: Strong executive presence with demonstrated ability to influence and communicate across all organizational levels.

Don’t meet all the requirements on the list?

A resume only goes so far in expressing who you are and the unique perspectives you bring. If you believe your skills and experience align with the role—but you might not check all the boxes—we want to hear from you. We encourage candidates from all work backgrounds, equity-seeking communities and experience levels to apply. If you’re seeking a career where your drive, perspective and growth are celebrated, we want to hear from you.

We’re dedicated to building a workforce reflective of those within our communities, and a culture where our team members are equipped with what they need to succeed—their way. Part of creating an inclusive workplace is recognizing our role in advancing Truth and Reconciliation. We are committed to meeting and exceeding the standards set out in the Partnership Accreditation in Indigenous Relations program created by the Canadian Council for Indigenous Business.

What happens next?

If you are shortlisted, you’ll hear from us after the posting closes. Check out our How We Hire page to learn more about our hiring process. If you need any accommodations throughout this process, please let us know at talentteam@atb.com

Stay in touch

We’re excited that you’re interested in a career with ATB. Follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram to learn more about what our team is up to.

Org. Setting and Reporting

The Capacity Development and Implementation Bureau (CDI) contributes to all of ICAO's Strategic Goals, namely: (i) Every Flight is Safe and Secure; (ii) Aviation is Environmentally Sustainable; (iii) Aviation Delivers Seamless, Accessible, and Reliable Mobility for All; (iv) No Country Left Behind; (v) The International Civil Aviation Convention and Other Treaties, Laws and Regulations Address All Challenges; and (vi) The Economic Development of Air Transport Assures the Delivery of Economic Prosperity and Societal Well-Being for All. It helps Member States turn ICAO Standards and policies into effective and sustainable results. Through needs-based implementation support, projects, training, and innovative products and services, CDI helps States close implementation gaps and build lasting aviation capacity, in line with the "No Country Left Behind" strategic goal. The Bureau manages ICAO’s Capacity Development and Implementation Programme (CDIP) across all Regions, including field operations and procurement services. It also oversees ICAO’s global aviation training activities, including the TRAINAIR PLUS Programme, and its revenue-generating products and services. CDI supports two of the Organization’s High Priority Enablers: “Partnerships, Resource Mobilization and Financial Sustainability” and “Gender Equality and Attracting New Talent to Aviation.” Across these activities, the Bureau oversees planning, budgeting, quality assurance and risk management to provide coordinated, high-quality support to States and help maintain ICAO’s financial sustainability. The Deputy Director reports to the Director, CDI (D/CDI), and manages the Bureau’s operations in line with the Director’s instructions. The Deputy Director oversees CDI’s business planning, quality management and continuous improvement, and represents the Director when required. The role carries full responsibility for managing the staff and resources under its authority, including setting priorities, assigning work, coaching staff and evaluating performance.

Responsibilities

Function 1 (incl. Expected results) Contributes to the formulation of the Bureau’s strategic priorities and work programme under the Director’s guidance, coordinates the preparation of business and operational plans, budget and staffing proposals for the Director’s consideration, and oversees the management of human and financial resources within delegated authority, achieving results such as:

Contributes to the formulation of the Bureau’s strategic priorities and work programme, ensuring alignment with the ICAO Strategic Plan and organizational priorities.
Coordinates the preparation of the Bureau’s Business and Operating Plans for the Director’s review, and monitors implementation and performance against agreed objectives.
Coordinates annual and triennial staffing and budget requirements, including workforce and succession planning, and prepares related documentation for the Director’s review and submission to the approving authorities.
Ensures consistent financial management across CDI’s funding mechanisms to support informed decision-making and resource allocation.
Recommends changes to the Bureau’s structure and working methods for the Director’s consideration, in response to developments in the business environment and industry.
Directs and manages staff within delegated authority, sets priorities, delegates tasks, evaluates performance, promotes teamwork and oversees recruitment in accordance with ICAO’s rules and selection procedures. Function 2 (incl. Expected results) Directs the Capacity Development and Implementation Programme (CDIP) and ICAO's global aviation training activities, including field operations, procurement and the TRAINAIR PLUS Programme, and ensures a One-ICAO approach with Regional Offices and other Bureaus, achieving results such as:
Directs the strategy and work programme of the CDIP, so that implementation support projects are delivered efficiently and to a high standard.
Directs the planning, development and deployment of ICAO's aviation training activities, and of the TRAINAIR PLUS Programme.
Ensures a One-ICAO approach by aligning CDIP activities with the Regular Programme, Regional Offices and other Bureaus, including sharing implementation support data with the Air Navigation and Air Transport Bureaus.
Works with Regional Offices to identify and deliver projects that address States' deficiencies, including Significant Safety and Security Concerns, in support of the No Country Left Behind goal and the ICAO Policy on Implementation Support.
Coordinates CDI's input to the Monitoring and Assistance Review Board (MARB), and monitors and reports on the support provided to MARB States. Function 3 (incl. Expected results) Leads the development and management of ICAO's revenue-generating products and services, including product development, marketing and sales, to strengthen the Organization's financial sustainability, achieving results such as:
Directs the strategy and portfolio of ICAO's revenue-generating products and services, including events, publications, licensing and data services, and the development of new products and services, so they meet Member States' and stakeholders' needs and support the Regular Budget.
Directs the marketing, sales, e-commerce and distribution of ICAO products and services, including printing and publication services.
Meets the approved targets and ensures that revenue-generating activities follow ICAO's applicable policies, pricing principles and intellectual property requirements, and monitors and reports on their financial performance.
Promotes the identification and assessment of new funding opportunities for the Organization, including new revenue streams, business models and commercial partnerships, and prepares proposals for CDI to submit to the relevant decision-making bodies. Function 4 (incl. Expected results) Leads the High Priority Enablers under CDI's responsibility, including Partnerships, Resource Mobilization and Financial Sustainability, and Gender Equality and Attracting New Talent to Aviation, achieving results such as:
Leads the development and implementation of ICAO's Resource Mobilization Strategy, including the ICAO Global Appeal, to secure voluntary contributions for the Organization's priorities.
Builds and maintains strategic partnerships with Member States, donors, development partners, international organizations and other stakeholders that provide voluntary contributions or in-kind support, including through dialogues with development partners and high-level pledging events.
Meets approved resource mobilization targets, strengthens resource mobilization capacity across the Secretariat, including in the Regional Offices, and coordinates resource mobilization efforts throughout ICAO.
Directs the Gender Equality Programme, the Next Generation of Aviation Professionals (NGAP) Programme and the ICAO Global Ambassadors Programme, to help build a diverse, future-ready aviation workforce.
Monitors and reports on progress under both High Priority Enablers, including the voluntary contributions mobilized and the results achieved. Function 5 (incl. Expected results) Leads quality management, continuous improvement and digital evolution in CDI, including the Quality Management System, change management, and follow-up on audits and evaluations, achieving results such as:
Maintains and improves CDI's Quality Management System, including the Project Quality Assurance Process, so that the Bureau's projects, products and services meet consistent quality standards.
Leads the review and improvement of the Bureau's business processes, policies and procedures to increase efficiency, accountability and client satisfaction.
Directs CDI's digital strategy and the development of its systems and tools, in coordination with the Organization's information and communications technology function.
Ensures that recommendations from internal and external audits, evaluations and oversight bodies, such as the Joint Inspection Unit (JIU) and the Evaluation and Audit Advisory Committee (EAAC), are implemented on time.
Contributes to the ICAO Continuous Organizational Improvement (COI) Programme and leads CDI's related change management initiatives. Function 6 (incl. Expected results) Represents CDI and provides strategic advice to senior management and governing bodies, and the Implementation Support Group (ISG) including leading the preparation of documentation for the Council, the Technical Cooperation Committee (TCC) and the Finance Committee (FIC), and other meetings achieving results such as:
Leads the preparation of working papers, reports and briefings for the Council, the TCC, the FIC and the Assembly, making sure they are accurate, timely and consistent with the Organization's positions.
Provides strategic and policy advice to the Director and senior management on capacity development, implementation support and related matters.
Acts as Secretary to the Implementation Support Group (ISG), ensuring the effective conduct of its meetings and identifying where CDI can help implement agreed directions.
Represents CDI and the Director, as required, at meetings of governing bodies, conferences, high-level events and external forums.
Promotes the role and value of CDI within the Secretariat and with Member States, partners and other stakeholders.
Ensures that the decisions and recommendations of the governing bodies that concern CDI are followed up and implemented. Function 7 (incl. Expected results) Performs other related duties, as assigned.

Competencies

Professionalism: Thorough knowledge of ICAO’s functions, programmes and activities related to aviation safety, aviation security, environmental protection, and safety/security audits. Knowledge of the Convention on International Civil Aviation and its Annexes, ICAO Standards and Recommended Practices (SARPs) and their application. Understanding of ICAO’s Strategic Objectives, and its global and regional aviation plans. Proven ability in developing/managing aviation-related projects and managing procurement of goods and services. Proven ability to plan, direct and supervise a broad area of institutional work, and to decide or advise on solutions to important problems of policy and practice. Demonstrated leadership ability, initiative and maturity of judgment. Excellent ability to write clearly and concisely, and to maintain harmonious working relationships in a multinational environment. Proven ability to work in a team environment. Ability to deal with complex issues with diplomacy and tact. Excellent ability to use computers, latest multimedia software and contemporary networks. Shows pride in work and in achievements; demonstrates professional competence and mastery of the subject matter; is conscientious and efficient in meeting commitments, observing deadlines and achieving results; is motivated by professional rather than personal concerns; shows persistence when faced with difficult problems or challenges; remains calm in stressful situations. Accountability: Takes ownership for all responsibilities and honours commitments; delivers outputs for which one has responsibility within prescribed time, cost and quality standards; operates in compliance with organizational regulations and rules; supports subordinates, provides oversight and takes responsibility for delegated assignments; takes personal responsibility for his/her own shortcomings and those of the work unit, where applicable. Communication: Speaks and writes clearly and effectively; listens to others, correctly interprets messages from others and responds appropriately; asks questions to clarify, and exhibits interest in having two-way communication; tailors language, tone, style, and format to match the audience; demonstrates openness in sharing information and keeping people informed. Job Description

Title:
Director, Global Marketing & Sales Enablement

Id:
21681

Type:
FullTime

Location:
Bolton, ON

Husky TechnologiesTM a company with a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships, a strong sense of community and a unique culture and values. We are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM Canadian manufacturing facilities and global headquarters are located in Bolton, Ontario on a large, beautiful campus located just 20 minutes north of Toronto’s Pearson International Airport. Features include a fitness and wellness center, intramural sports activities, on-site cafeteria, and clean, state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities with outstanding safety records. We offer a great work environment and competitive total compensation package, including above market retirement savings plan and market competitive group benefits.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Director / GM, Global Marketing & Sales Enablement
is responsible for defining and driving Husky's global brand strategy, leading B2B marketing and demand generation, advancing sustainability advocacy and industry engagement, delivering actionable market intelligence, and improving global sales effectiveness.

Reporting to the EVP, Sales & Marketing, this leader will strengthen Husky's market position and industry influence, build an integrated commercial support function, and connect market insights, customer engagement, and sales capabilities to deliver measurable business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Global Brand Strategy, Marketing & Industry Advocacy
Own Husky's global brand strategy, positioning, identity, and differentiation, ensuring a compelling and consistent presence across markets and customer touchpoints.
Develop and execute global B2B marketing programs that generate qualified leads and commercial opportunities through digital channels, integrated campaigns, account-based marketing, trade shows, and customer events.
Lead Husky's sustainability advocacy and industry engagement strategy, partnering with industry associations, customers, and value-chain stakeholders to advance science-based understanding of plastics, address misconceptions, and promote responsible use, recycling, and circularity.
Represent Husky's perspectives in relevant industry initiatives and advocacy programs, strengthening its reputation as a credible technology leader and constructive voice in sustainability discussions.
Establish metrics to evaluate brand strength, marketing contribution to pipeline, and the reach and effectiveness of advocacy initiatives.
Market Intelligence & Strategic Insights
Lead a centralized market intelligence and research capability serving Sales, Product Line Management, Strategy, Investor Relations, and executive leadership.
Deliver actionable insights on market trends, competitive dynamics, customer needs, sustainability-related market developments, and emerging growth opportunities.
Support strategic planning, market prioritization, product portfolio decisions, and commercial growth initiatives.
Establish systematic approaches to market research, competitive intelligence, and voice-of-customer analysis.
Strategic Customer Engagement & Sales Enablement
Lead the development of executive-level content and strategic narratives for Top-to-Top (T2T) customer meetings, supporting senior leadership and strategic account engagement.
Develop high-impact sales enablement content, including value propositions, product and solution presentations, competitive positioning, case studies, and customer value tools.
Partner with Sales, Product Line Management, and Engineering to ensure differentiated, consistent, and customer-focused messaging.
Equip global commercial teams with the content, knowledge, and capabilities required to engage customers effectively and win business.
Sales Effectiveness & Commercial Excellence
Partner with Sales leadership to improve sales productivity, commercial processes, opportunity management, and overall sales effectiveness.
Drive adoption of sales methodologies, CRM capabilities, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions to strengthen commercial execution.
Develop scalable approaches to sales training, onboarding, best-practice sharing, and continuous improvement of capability.
Establish performance metrics and improvement initiatives focused on sales efficiency, conversion rates, win rates, and commercial productivity.

Leadership & Experience

The successful candidate will be a strategic, commercially oriented leader with proven experience in global brand management, complex industrial B2B marketing, market intelligence, and sales enablement.

Experience engaging industry associations, building external partnerships, and shaping industry narratives around sustainability, circularity, or related topics is highly desirable.

The role requires strong business acumen, the ability to lead global multidisciplinary teams, and the credibility to influence executive stakeholders while translating market insights and brand strategy into measurable commercial outcomes.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or other advanced business degree considered an asset
10+ years of progressive leadership experience in global B2B marketing, brand strategy, commercial excellence, or sales enablement within a complex industrial, manufacturing, technology, or capital equipment environment
Demonstrated success developing and executing integrated marketing strategies that drive brand growth, lead generation, customer engagement, and measurable commercial results across global markets.
Proven experience leveraging market intelligence, competitive insights, and voice-of-customer research to influence business strategy, portfolio decisions, and growth initiatives.
Strong track record leading cross-functional and global teams, influencing executive stakeholders, and driving adoption of sales methodologies, CRM platforms, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions to improve sales effectiveness.

Vacancy: Replacement

Pay Range: $150,000.00 - 185,000.00

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky Technologies TM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks.

Husky TechnologiesTM is committed to developing inclusive, barrier-free selection processes and work environments. If contacted in relation to a job opportunity or testing, you should advise the member of the Talent Acquisition team in a timely fashion of any disabilities that requires accommodation measures in order to enable you to be assessed in a fair and equitable manner.

Information received relating to accommodation measures will be addressed confidentially.

No agency or telephone inquiries please.
